justification.recall_at_5_max_drop: At most five percentage points loss relative to the real baseline; chosen before rerunning candidates.
justification.faithfulness_min: At least 90% of generated answers must pass the documented lexical-support proxy; semantic limitations must be reported.
justification.p95_latency_max_ms: Local CPU demo latency budget is three minutes per query; a deployment policy, not a claim of measured latency.
justification.abstention_correctness_min: All unanswerable questions must abstain and must not regress against baseline.
